title: Pin physical pages and logical order separately
when: A scanned exam has reordered or image-only pages.
do: Hash original bytes; retain physical page identity.
Bind logical order explicitly; Daechi instance is [1,2,4,3,5,6].
check: All physical pages occur exactly once; question numbering matches reading order.
limitation: The Daechi permutation is instance data, never a default for another exam.
